target.title: feat(sessions): create concise titles for saved sessions
target.body:
## Summary

What problem does this PR solve?

- Fix classification: Root-cause feature completion for opt-in model-created session titles.
- Root cause: Saved sessions had no durable generated-title source of truth, so session lists fell back to manual names, first user message snippets, or session ids.
- Why this is root-cause fix: `autoTitle` is created once in the reply lifecycle, stored on the session entry, preserved without refreshing session activity, cleared with reset/rollover state, and projected to gateway/Control UI instead of being recomputed by display fallbacks.
- Patch quality notes: The broad catches are intentional isolation for a non-blocking background title task; failures log or no-op instead of interrupting the user reply. The `null`/`false` returns are explicit skip/no-title states for invalid, absent, stale, manually titled, or unreadable sessions.

Why does this matter now?

- Why it matters / User impact: Users with many saved sessions only had manual names, first-message fallbacks, or session-id fallbacks, so session history was hard to scan and search. When `sessionTitle.enabled` is true, users can identify conversations by concise stored titles instead of first-message snippets or ids.

What is the intended outcome?

- Maintainer-ready confidence: High for the scoped code update after focused validation, local real gateway proof, Control UI visual proof, and passing local ClawSweeper review; maintainer product/privacy/auth acceptance remains maintainer-owned before merge.

What is intentionally out of scope?

- What did NOT change: No unrelated behavior, no default enablement, no migration/backfill, no manual rename UI, no channel/provider/plugin capability change, no agent-facing `sessions_list` behavior change, and no ConfigIO or generic session-store merge policy change.
- Out of scope: Manual rename UI, migration/backfill for existing sessions, default-enabling generated titles, provider/channel/plugin capability changes, agent-facing `sessions_list` behavior, ConfigIO typing, generic session-store merge policy, and test-project routing.

What does success look like?

Enabled sessions with enough direct user turns get one bounded stored title; manual titles and stale async writes prevent overwrite; reset/new/rollover clears generated titles while preserving manual display names and session activity ordering; gateway and Control UI rows can display and search the generated title.

What should reviewers focus on?

- Architecture / source-of-truth check: `autoTitle` is persisted as session metadata and projected outward; gateway and UI do not maintain a second title source. Runtime auth selection for this path is kept behind internal runtime code so the public runtime-auth helper contract is not expanded.
- Related open PR / same-contract scan: Related context is tracked in #89705. This update is scoped to the existing PR branch for #77165 and does not open a competing new PR or broaden the public provider-auth helper contract.

## Linked context

Which issue does this close?

Closes #77165

Which issues, PRs, or discussions are related?

Related #89705

Was this requested by a maintainer or owner?

ClawSweeper asked for explicit privacy/cost framing and Mantis-style visual proof that generated titles show up in the Control UI session list and search.

## Real behavior proof (required for external PRs)

- Behavior or issue addressed: Enabled sessions can generate a durable `autoTitle`, expose it through `openclaw sessions --json` and gateway `sessions.list`, and render/search it in the Control UI session list.
- Real environment tested: Local OpenClaw run with isolated state, synthetic prompts only, `sessionTitle.enabled: true`, a local mock OpenAI provider, and a real local gateway. Control UI proof used the real Control UI Vite bundle with a browser-injected mock gateway payload shaped like `sessions.list` rows containing `autoTitle` only.
- Exact steps or command run after this patch: Ran synthetic direct-user turns through the embedded agent session store, observed title generation through the production `maybeGenerateSessionTitle` path, queried `openclaw sessions --json`, queried gateway `sessions.list`, searched gateway sessions by the generated title, then loaded the Control UI session list with an `autoTitle`-only row and searched for that title.
- Evidence after fix (screenshot, recording, terminal capture, console output, redacted runtime log, linked artifact, or copied live output):

```text
captured_at: 2026-07-03T11:08:15Z
provider_mode: local mock-openai server
config: sessionTitle.enabled=true, turnsBeforeTitle=3, maxChars=50, model=openai/gpt-5.5, gateway.auth.mode=none
agent turns: 3 direct user turns recorded through the embedded agent session store
title hook: ok=true autoTitle=OPENCLAW_E2E_OK_ALPINE_OTTER_ROUTE_MAP sessionId=df-session-title-proof-mock-20260703
openclaw sessions --json row: autoTitle=OPENCLAW_E2E_OK_ALPINE_OTTER_ROUTE_MAP modelProvider=openai model=gpt-5.5
gateway sessions.list row: autoTitle=OPENCLAW_E2E_OK_ALPINE_OTTER_ROUTE_MAP modelProvider=openai model=gpt-5.5
gateway sessions.list search: search=OPENCLAW_E2E_OK_ALPINE_OTTER_ROUTE_MAP returned the same session
```

Control UI browser visual proof:

```text
captured_at: 2026-07-03T15:21:17Z
ui_mode: Control UI Vite e2e server with browser-injected mock gateway
input row: key=agent:main:explicit:df-session-title-proof-mock-20260703 autoTitle="Alpine Otter Route Map" with no manual label/displayName
initial session list: generated title visible; 2 rows shown
session list search: search="Alpine Otter Route Map" returned 1 row and hid the non-matching "Different Project" row
screenshots: control-ui-session-title-list.png, control-ui-session-title-search.png
```

- Observed result after fix: The generated title was persisted, returned in CLI JSON, returned by a real local gateway `sessions.list`, matched gateway search, rendered in the Control UI session list, and filtered correctly by Control UI search.
- What was not tested: External-model title quality and provider billing behavior were not exercised; the title proof used synthetic prompts and a local mock OpenAI provider.
- Proof limitations or environment constraints: Browser Control UI proof uses the real Control UI bundle with a gateway-shaped mock payload; the separate live proof covers production title generation plus real local gateway `sessions.list`/search. External-model proof remains a disclosed limitation rather than a hidden code claim.
- Before evidence (optional but encouraged): Before this branch, saved sessions had no persisted generated-title field and Control UI session rows could not render/search an `autoTitle`-only session title.

## Tests and validation

Which commands did you run?

- Target test file: `src/auto-reply/reply/session-title-generator.test.ts`, `src/auto-reply/reply/conversation-label-generator.test.ts`, `src/auto-reply/reply/get-reply-run.media-only.test.ts`, `src/commands/sessions.test.ts`, `src/gateway/session-utils.test.ts`, `src/gateway/server.sessions.list-changed.test.ts`, `src/plugins/runtime/runtime-model-auth.runtime.test.ts`, `ui/src/ui/controllers/sessions.test.ts`, and `ui/src/ui/views/sessions.test.ts`.
- Post-sync session-title core tests: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/auto-reply/reply/session-title-generator.test.ts src/auto-reply/reply/conversation-label-generator.test.ts src/auto-reply/reply/get-reply-run.media-only.test.ts src/commands/sessions.test.ts src/plugins/runtime/runtime-model-auth.runtime.test.ts` — passed 5 files / 138 tests.
- Post-sync Control UI session-title tests: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/ui/controllers/sessions.test.ts ui/src/ui/views/sessions.test.ts` — passed 2 files / 110 tests.
- Post-sync config/plugin/diff checks: `pnpm config:docs:check && pnpm plugin-sdk:api:check && git diff --check` — passed after regenerating config and plugin SDK baselines for current `origin/main`.
- Gateway session event test added after the ClawSweeper sandbox limitation: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/server.sessions.list-changed.test.ts` — passed 2 files / 48 tests.
- Local ClawSweeper commit review on the current committed diff: `result=nothing_found`, `confidence=high`, `highest_severity=none`, `check_conclusion=success`.

What regression coverage was added or updated?

- Scenario locked in: Enabled sessions with enough direct user turns get one bounded stored title; manual titles and stale async writes prevent overwrite; reset/new/rollover clears generated titles while preserving manual display names and session activity ordering.
- Coverage includes config opt-in, runtime model/auth forwarding, transcript filtering, input caps, manual title precedence, stale async write skip, post-reply metadata notification, activity timestamp preservation for generated-title writes, reset/rollover cleanup, gateway row/search/event behavior, and Control UI event patch/filter/display behavior.

What failed before this fix, if known?

- Why this is the smallest reliable guardrail: The feature spans title creation, persistence, reset/rollover cleanup, gateway projection, and UI projection; the final diff removes earlier nonessential `sessions_list`, ConfigIO, generic store merge, test-routing, and public helper expansion work.

If no test was added, why not?

Tests were added and updated across title generation, auth-profile routing, gateway projection, CLI JSON output, session reset/rollover behavior, and Control UI rendering/search.

## Risk checklist

Did user-visible behavior change? (`Yes/No`)

Yes, but only when `sessionTitle.enabled` is explicitly set to true. Default behavior remains unchanged.

Did config, environment, or migration behavior change? (`Yes/No`)

Yes. This adds a default-off `sessionTitle` config group and additive `autoTitle` session metadata. There is no migration/backfill.

Did security, auth, secrets, network, or tool execution behavior change? (`Yes/No`)

Yes. When explicitly enabled, the background title task can send bounded direct-user transcript excerpts to the selected title model using the session model/auth-profile routing.

What is the highest-risk area?

- Risk labels considered: compatibility, session-state, public config/schema, auth-provider routing, availability, privacy/cost boundary.
- Risk explanation: The highest-risk area is privacy/cost from sending transcript excerpts to the selected title model when the feature is explicitly enabled.

How is that risk mitigated?

- Why acceptable: The feature is opt-in/default-off; it sends only direct user text, skips heartbeat, internal-system, tool-mediated, media-only, or textless records, caps both per-message and total model input, skips manual-title sessions, guards stale writes by `sessionId`, writes `autoTitle` without refreshing `updatedAt`, runs after reply delivery, and logs/no-ops on title failures without changing the user reply.

## Current review state

What is the next action?

Run the daily-fix submit flow to update the existing PR branch and body, then wait for remote CI and maintainer review.

What is still waiting on author, maintainer, CI, or external proof?

Remote CI and maintainer review are still pending after submit. Maintainer approval is still needed for the new default-off config surface, persisted metadata, auth-provider routing choice, and transcript privacy/cost boundary. External-model proof is intentionally disclosed as not tested.

Which bot or reviewer comments were addressed?

- RF-001 [P1] — fixed with current-head proof: `sessionTitle` is explicit default-off config, `autoTitle` is additive session metadata, generated titles are cleared on reset/new/rollover while manual display names remain authoritative, config/plugin SDK baselines were regenerated, and focused regression tests cover persistence, cleanup, CLI JSON, gateway rows/events, and Control UI rows/search.
- RF-002 [P1] — maintainer-decision disclosed with current-head mitigations: the PR body now states the privacy/cost boundary explicitly. Title generation is default-off, reads only bounded direct user text from the transcript head, skips heartbeat/internal/tool-mediated/media-only/textless records, caps model input, runs after reply delivery, and failure does not affect the user reply.
- RF-003 [P1] — fixed/disclosed with current-head proof: the title path reuses session model/auth-profile routing intentionally, now forwards selected `workspaceDir`, `authProfileId`, `preferredProfile`, and provider runtime `agentDir` through internal runtime-auth selection. Regression tests cover user-selected and auto-selected auth profiles. Maintainer approval is still needed for the product/auth boundary.
- RF-004 [P2] — maintainer-decision/advisory: no narrow automated repair remains hidden. The remaining decision is maintainer approval of the new config, persisted metadata, auth-provider routing, and transcript privacy boundary; this PR provides the code, tests, local real behavior proof, Control UI visual proof, and explicit risk disclosure for that review.
